notes.title: Painkiller - Weapons Trailer
notes.content:
👿💥 Welcome to raw, reckless, demon-obliterating firepower! Get ready to dive into a brutal lineup of devastating weaponry, some newly forged, others ripped straight from the old-school playbook.

From flesh-shredding shurikens to limb-launching rockets, this arsenal is built for turning your enemies into gristle & gibs!

[previewyoutube=4dUKtbucEOk;full][previewyoutube=2J41CouSSWU;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

In Painkiller, you’ll unleash hell with seven destructive weapons, each offering primary and alternative fire modes, elemental effects such as fire, ice, electro, and kinetic, and upgrades of different abilities to provide unique bonus effects:

[list]
[*] Electrodriver: Barrage enemies with rapid-firing shurikens that bounce off hard surfaces.
[*] Stakegun: Hurls high-damage stakes that can impale foes from long-range.
[*] SMG: Unleashes loads of ammo in short, rapid-fire bursts.
[*] Handcannon: Decimate enemies from long range with deadly precision.
[*] Shotgun: Spits destructive pellets at short range that can damage and stagger multiple foes.
[*] Rocket Launcher: Discharges a rocket projectile with a devastating blast radius that can stagger even heavy enemies.
[*] Painkiller: a versatile weapon with a brutal melee attack that hooks onto enemies, shreds them to pieces, and refills your ammo.
[/list]

notes.title: Painkiller is Back!
notes.content:
[h3]🤘 Painkiller is back: bloodier and more brutal than ever! [/h3]

Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled experience that brings you epic co-op action, relentless waves of enemies, and devastating weaponry designed to chew through the underworld. Team up with friends and stand strong against demonic forces in this explosive comeback, where your skills and strategy will be put to the ultimate test.

Explore eldritch levels filled with nightmarish creatures and uncover secrets that will aid you in battle. With a variety of weapons and unique abilities at your disposal, you’ll execute devastating combos to annihilate the hordes that threaten to consume you.

This thrilling adventure is set to explode onto Steam in Fall 2025. ⛧ Rip open the gates of the underworld and unleash chaos!

[previewyoutube=WDqGyzeXg4I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Wishlist now to be the first to step into the carnage![/h3]
